OCPP16-ERR-GroundFailure.title: Ground failure fault
OCPP16-ERR-GroundFailure.text: A ground failure is a current leak to earth. The charger stops and the connector stays locked until a technician clears it.

POL-REFUND-1.title: Refund policy
POL-REFUND-1.text: A driver can request a refund after a failed charge.
